person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and third person. The official opening sustains external “he/she” narration, while the Goodreads event excerpts extend that pattern into later scenes and across focal characters including Reacher and an unnamed woman. First-person forms in q01769, q01770, q01771, q01772, q01777, q01780, q01781, q01783, and q01784 belong to a written message, dialogue, gnomic material, or an embedded joke rather than autonomous first-person narration. The generic “you” in q01787 is likewise not story-specific second person. An explicit whole-book description and an independently reproduced interior passage corroborate THIRD, with no credible evidence of sustained narration in another person.
